page.overview:
Who is Hoodvincible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Burly (attempted victim) Shrapnel † (indirect victim) Pangea (attempted victim) Unnamed hero (attempted victim) Invincible Atom Eve ReAnimen Cecil Stedman (indirectly) Global Defense Agency (indirectly)

Hoodvincible is a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe.

Hoodvincible was assembled by Angstrom Levy to help start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension.
